basis: Working bars from strategy/master-scoreboard-2026-11-04.md (80% repair start, p50 check under 1 s, 97% precision). They are placeholders until the four product calls are answered; changing one is a bar change, not a regression fix.

repair_start_rate.note: floor_starts is the gate: the nightly fails when fewer than floor_starts - tolerance_cases of the 24 cases start a repair. Raise the floor in the change that earns a gain; never lower it. 7/24 was the 2026-11-02 manual harness result (#11402).

first_useful_result_p50_ms.note: Advisory: wall time of `ripr check` on a tiny crate, runner-dependent, never gates.

agent_fix_success_rate.note: Read from the dx-scoreboard agent board (ingest:agent-as-user); not measured until #12902 lands a cohort receipt.

false_actionable_rate.note: Read from the dx-scoreboard verdict-corpus trust metrics; the page reports the rate and does not restate it as precision.
